protocol.warmup: Same fixture, first 2,000 rows, two REML iterations before timing.
protocol.scheduling: Serial fresh processes; candidate/pre-Gram variants rotated between three repetitions.
protocol.thread_limits: BLAS limits varied independently of NUMBA_NUM_THREADS; OMP_NUM_THREADS follows Numba; NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS remains one.
protocol.baselines: One master reference per matched 1/1 and 4/4 thread setting. Three candidate/pre-Gram repeats for 100,000-row cases. One 300,000-row and Gamma run per source; no master 300,000-row retry.
protocol.limitations: Warmed fits on one host, three timing repetitions or marked single runs. Comparison with pre-Gram measures the whole correctness integration, not only the PR-review follow-up. Profiles are excluded from timing ratios. RSS is process high-water through fit, not isolated allocation.
